messages:
Sarah (AE): ArborBank wants to start a 6-week POC next Mon. Scope: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM ~25k users (backfill + incremental), group->role mapping, RBAC sync, multi-subdomain verification, and security questionnaire. Need runbook + provisional pricing by Friday.
Miguel (SE): Quick ask: nested groups? custom SCIM attrs (employeeId/costCenter)? Hosted or Dedicated preferred for backfill?
Alex (ArborBank): We use nested groups and will send CSV mapping for role transforms. We prefer hosted but will take Dedicated if necessary for performance.
Miguel (SE): We support nested flattening and custom attrs. For 25k backfill we recommend Dedicated to avoid rate limits; estimate 30-60m with batch tuning. Temporary SCIM rate-lift process included in runbook. Example mapping snippet: `okta.group -> product.role: "arbor_admins"->"org_admin"`.
Priya (Security): Need SOC2, encryption-at-rest details, KMS option for Private, audit log retention (they asked 90d), and DPA for EU. Any PHI in SCIM?
Erin (Legal): Confirm DPA and HIPAA path if PHI. Also SAML cert rotation and metadata upload support.
Tom (Sales Eng): Provisional pricing suggestion: 6-week uplift for Dedicated (2x GPUs + provisioning IO) ballpark $6k-$9k. I will confirm with finance.
Sarah (AE): Action list: Miguel -> POC runbook (SCIM snippets, nested group handling, domain verification steps, temp rate-lift). Priya/Erin -> complete SQ + DPA/HIPAA checks. Tom -> provisional pricing. I'll schedule kickoff once runbook is ready. :thumbsup:
